root_cause: success_loaded unconditionally cleared _ackSuppressed. Any 2xx from a public/anonymous endpoint (translations/i18n/health probes) reset the sticky ack that "Stay Here" installed. Next authed 401 reopened the modal. Storm on every few keystrokes.
fix: success_loaded now clears the visual overlay but does NOT lift _ackSuppressed. Only resetSessionAck() (Log Back In) or a full page reload can lift the sticky ack.

root_cause: Same root cause as B-09 — the operator report of "Leave this page? every keystroke" was in fact the session-expired modal storm.
